profile.name: Helmut Chaparro Sandoval
profile.summary: Electronics engineer and full-stack developer in Bogotá. Over six years building end to end: PCBs, embedded firmware, .NET backends, Edge AI in the field. Founder of DevKit Electronics S.A.S and owner and founder of Poimen Labs S.A.S.
profile.about: For over six years I have worked on projects that combine hardware, software and data: from foreign trade platforms to Edge AI, FPGA and applied robotics.
tags: Owner and founder of Poimen Labs S.A.S

experience.summary: STEM education company I founded. We build hardware, software and curricula that work in real classrooms and labs.
bullets: I lead strategy, operations and product in engineering and science education for children, teenagers, university students and professionals.
I design and deliver end-to-end solutions: curriculum architecture, multilayer PCBs, embedded firmware, educational software, web platforms and lab equipment.
I built a portfolio of courses, robotics kits and laboratory systems adopted by schools and universities.
I lead multidisciplinary teams across electronics, software and pedagogy.
I turn complex engineering (STM32, IoT, 3D fabrication, automation) into learning experiences.

experience.summary: AgriTech company I founded and own, bringing electronics, automation, sensing and data to Colombian agriculture, from prototype to field deployment.
bullets: I founded Poimen Labs and own it; I co-lead the company's strategy, engineering direction and delivery of agricultural technology solutions in Colombia.
I design integrated hardware and software for the field: sensor nodes, edge data acquisition, control and rural connectivity layers.
I develop low-cost monitoring and automation systems for crops and livestock, with energy-efficient firmware.
I turn field data into visualization, alerts and decision support for farmers.
I manage the full cycle: requirements with farmers, PCB and enclosure, firmware, backend, field pilots and iterative improvement.

experience.summary: Enterprise software for international trade, customs and logistics operations.
bullets: Designed .NET solutions for client management, customs processes, imports, DIAN compliance, logistics and integrations.
Developed solutions for high-volume clients, built for scalability, security and performance.
Worked across the entire stack, from SQL Server data models to APIs and front end, in an agile remote team.

experience.summary: Teaching robotics and embedded AI to help close the STEAM education gap.
bullets: Led STEAM initiatives to reduce the education gap in public institutions.
Designed robotics, automation and embedded AI courses, integrated into the curriculum projects.
Guided students from their first circuit to a working autonomous prototype.

experience.role: Software Developer and Educational Robotics Consultant
experience.summary: Educational robotics taken from circuit to classroom, ready for the market.
bullets: Managed educational robotics projects for sale to district and educational institutions.
Programmed educational robots, developed electronic circuits and provided on-site consulting.
Bridged engineering and sales, turning technical capabilities into products that institutions could adopt.

experience.org: Computers for Education · Ministry of Education
experience.summary: Mechatronic prototypes and STEAM programs that reached vulnerable communities across the country.
bullets: Led the full design and development cycle of mechatronic prototypes using a STEAM methodology.
Applied PCB design, 3D modeling, robotics and programming (Python, C/C++) for education and vulnerable populations.
Trained teachers and communities so they could sustain the technology on their own.

experience.summary: Leading student communities in robotics, biomedical and humanitarian technology.
bullets: Held chair positions in the IEEE Student Branch, RAS, EMBS and the Humanitarian Technologies chapter.
Currently chairing the RAS, SIGHT and CIS student chapters.
I organize technical events, workshops and activities that connect students with real-world engineering.

education.institution: Francisco José de Caldas District University

domains.title: Embedded systems
domains.tech: ARM · RTOS · STM32 · ESP32 · C/C++ · FreeRTOS · SoC
domains.summary: Firmware for ARM (STM32) and ESP32 microcontrollers, written in C/C++ and running on FreeRTOS when the system calls for it. It underpins almost everything I build: educational kits, sensor nodes for the field and robots.
focus: C/C++ firmware on STM32 and ESP32, with a real-time operating system when needed
Low power consumption for battery-powered nodes in the field
Sensor acquisition, control and IoT connectivity
From breadboard prototype to custom board

domains.title: Hardware and PCB design
domains.tech: Altium Designer · KiCAD · EMI/EMC · LTSpice · Signal integrity
domains.summary: I design printed circuit boards from schematic to assembly, in Altium Designer and KiCAD. I look after signal integrity and electromagnetic compatibility from the layout stage, and I simulate in LTSpice before manufacturing.
focus: Multilayer PCBs for educational products and laboratory equipment
Board and enclosure for agricultural sensor nodes
Circuit simulation before manufacturing
Altium scholarship recipient in two professional PCB design programs

domains.title: Electrical and power systems
domains.tech: Power electronics · Control · Protection · Schematics · EMI/EMC
domains.summary: Power electronics and electrical systems: power supply, control and protection stages, documented in clear schematics and designed to coexist with the rest of the circuit without interference.
focus: Power supply and energy conversion stages
Control loops and protection circuits
Schematics and technical documentation
Electromagnetic compatibility criteria from the design stage

domains.title: Full-stack and software
domains.tech: .NET · C# · JavaScript · TypeScript · REST APIs · SQL Server · Azure DevOps
domains.summary: I develop software end to end: .NET and C# on the server, JavaScript and TypeScript on the client and SQL Server for the data. I have applied it in enterprise software for foreign trade and in the platforms of my own companies.
focus: REST services and APIs in .NET
Data models and queries in SQL Server
Web interfaces with JavaScript and TypeScript
Work in agile, remote teams with Azure DevOps

domains.title: Data engineering and analytics
domains.tech: ETL · Pipelines · SQL · Power BI · R · Dashboards · Reporting
domains.summary: I take data from its source to the decision: extraction and transformation, pipelines, SQL queries and dashboards in Power BI. At Poimen Labs I turn field readings into visualization, alerts and decision support for farmers.
focus: Pipelines and extract, transform and load processes
Analysis in SQL and R
Dashboards and reports in Power BI
Geospatial data: remote sensing and drones

domains.title: AI and machine learning
domains.tech: Python · TensorFlow · PyTorch · Edge AI · RAG · Computer vision
domains.summary: Machine learning models in Python with TensorFlow and PyTorch, with a particular interest in running them at the edge, on embedded hardware. I also work with computer vision and with retrieval-augmented generation systems and agents.
focus: Edge inference on my own hardware
Computer vision
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents built on language models
Embedded systems with AI courses as an instructor

domains.title: Digital design and FPGA
domains.tech: VHDL · Verilog · Xilinx · Intel · RTL · Timing closure
domains.summary: Digital design described in VHDL and Verilog for Xilinx and Intel FPGAs: from register-transfer level description to synthesis, simulation and timing closure.
focus: Hardware description in VHDL and Verilog
Synthesis and implementation in Vivado and Quartus
Simulation and verification
Timing analysis and closure

domains.title: Robotics and automation
domains.tech: ROS 2 · Gazebo · SLAM · Mechatronics · PID · Navigation
domains.summary: Robotics and mechatronics, from prototype to classroom: since 2021 I have designed, programmed and taught educational robots. I work with ROS 2 and Gazebo for simulation, navigation and mapping, and with PID control on the actuators.
focus: Mechatronic prototypes using a STEAM methodology
Educational kits and robots for schools and universities
Simulation and navigation with ROS 2 and Gazebo
I chair the IEEE Robotics and Automation student chapter

domains.title: Bioengineering
domains.tech: Biosensors · Signal processing · Laboratory instruments · Edge AI · Biomedical IoT
domains.summary: Instrumentation for measuring biological signals: biosensors, signal conditioning and processing, and connected biomedical devices with intelligence at the edge. It is an interest I also pursue through the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology community.
focus: Biosensors and biosignal acquisition
Digital signal processing
Laboratory instruments
Chair role in the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology student chapter

domains.title: Cloud, DevOps and systems
domains.tech: Docker · Linux · CI/CD · Git · Azure · Monitoring · Infrastructure
domains.summary: The infrastructure that keeps software running: Docker containers, Linux servers, continuous integration and deployment, and services on Azure, with monitoring to know what is happening in production.
focus: Containers with Docker
Linux system administration
Continuous integration and deployment with Git
Monitoring and infrastructure on Azure

competencias.name: NAVIRA-SATViRe
competencias.summary: Early warning system for landslides and slope failures. First place at the national hackathon.
competencias.detail: Built during the national hackathon organized by the National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD) and UNDP. It combines low-power sensor nodes with edge inference and an alert chain to give communities early warning of mass-movement events.

competencias.name: GDG Cartagena Hackathon
competencias.summary: Third place at the hackathon organized by Google Developer Group (GDG) Cartagena.

awards.title: Landslide early warning system
awards.desc: Winner of the national hackathon of the National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), with an early warning system for landslides and slope failures.
